label: Value-only ejection
type: the Couchbase-bucket policy under which only document values are ejected from memory, keys and metadata being retained.
note: Member of the ejection-policy closed set, promoted as a family: memory:ejection-policy clears the recurrence bar and memory:full-ejection does too, while the remaining members sit at 1. An enum promoted with some values missing is worse than useless - a consumer cannot tell an absent value from an invalid one - so the set is completed deliberately and the exception is recorded here rather than left implicit.
